verdict.rationale: Better Auth claims integrations with Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, Hono and 20+ more frameworks, and documents `auth.api` methods for authenticating users on the server. A community report confirms that moving from Next.js to Hono only required changing the router. The JWT plugin's JWKS endpoint could support stateless token verification, but the evidence never shows route-protection middleware or session checks running at the edge. Missing for 10: documented route-protection middleware, an explicit edge-runtime session verification path, per-framework SDK documentation, and hands-on corroboration of protecting routes.
